title: S11 config-service — API surface
description: Port 7710, prefix CFG-. Centralized config store/distribution: GET /healthz, /readyz, /configs, /config/{service}, /versions, /changes, /changes/watch (long-poll), /overrides, /flags, /stats; PUT /config/{service}, /flags/{name}; POST /reload, /overrides; DELETE /overrides. Effective config = stored blob deep-merged with the env override at read time. Every upsert bumps the revision, recomputes the SHA-256 content hash over canonical JSON, and appends a sequenced change event. Errors: CFG-2xx (203 unknown service, 204 bad flag/override), CFG-404 no route, CFG-001 bad JSON (400).

configUpsertRequest.description: PUT /config/{service} — upsert a service's config blob. The payload is the whole body minus the control fields, or the explicit 'payload' object when present.

env.description: Environment label for the blob; defaults to the config's default env.

updated_by.description: Actor name for the change log.

payload.description: Explicit payload; wins over the flattened-body form.

configUpsertResponse.description: 200 — created flag (true only for first registration) plus the stored blob.

configGetResponse.description: GET /config/{service} — the effective config (blob deep-merged with the env override when ?env= names one that has an override). 404 CFG-203 for unknown services.

configsListResponse.description: GET /configs — summary row per registered service.

versionsResponse.description: GET /versions[?service=] — per-service version table (revision + hash + history).

changesResponse.description: GET /changes?since=&limit= — the sequenced change log (config_update / override_set / override_clear / flag_change).

changesWatchResponse.description: GET /changes/watch?since=&timeout_ms=&service= — long-poll: holds the connection until a new event (seq > since, scoped to service when given) or the (bounded) timeout. Response is the wait result object spread at top level (changed/woken, seq, ...).

overrideSetRequest.description: POST /overrides — set an environment override deep-merged over the stored blob at read time (the stored blob is never mutated).

env.description: Environment label; defaults to the store's default env.

overrideSetResponse.description: 200 — the set-override result object spread at top level (service, env, found/created, keys touched, ...).

overrideClearRequest.description: DELETE /overrides — body {service, env?}; env absent clears all environments for the service.

overrideClearResponse.description: 200 — {ts_ns, found, ...}: found is false when no override existed (still 200, idempotent).

overrideListResponse.description: GET /overrides[?service=] — all overrides grouped per service/env.

flagListResponse.description: GET /flags — all feature flags with their bounded change history.

flagSetRequest.description: PUT /flags/{name} — set a flag value (typed: bool/number/string).

reloadResponse.description: POST /reload — no-op refresh broadcast; returns the current version table.

statsResponse.description: GET /stats — the store's stats view nested under 'store'.

revision.description: Monotonic per-service revision, bumped on every upsert.

hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical (key-sorted) JSON of the payload.

effectiveConfig.description: GET-time view: the blob possibly deep-merged with an env override, plus both the merged hash and the unmerged base_hash, and an override_applied flag.

base_hash.description: Hash of the unmerged stored blob (equals hash when no override applied).

flagState.description: One feature flag (cfgs.models.FlagState.to_dict) with bounded history.
